finding.title: Guard ref access after await in notification_providers.dart effect providers (SM-4)
finding.why: allProfilesReminderBootstrap, reminderSyncEffect and streakAlertSyncEffect all touch ref (read/watch) immediately after an await with no ref.mounted guard. If any of these keepAlive FutureProviders is invalidated or disposed while suspended past its first await (profile switch, container teardown during navigation/tests, hot-reload), the next ref access throws UnmountedRefException uncaught, leaving the provider's AsyncValue stuck in .error and silently freezing that profile's notification (re)scheduling until something else forces a rebuild.
finding.recommendation: Add `if (!ref.mounted) return;` immediately after each await, before any further ref access, in all three functions.
acceptance_criteria: A test that invalidates a watched dependency mid-flight (e.g. activeProfileIdProvider while profileListStreamProvider.future is pending) asserts the effect settles instead of throwing UnmountedRefException.
A Rule-0 grep/lint flags ref.read(/ref.watch( on a line whose nearest preceding statement in the same async function contains await with no intervening ref.mounted check.
